description: The socket twin of the agent's stop request (S55 T5, LC15): an inert row is filed — the daemon stamps the agent identity from the loop's IN-FLIGHT step (a params agent is refused by name: the request is an agent act, and the agent it names is the one running). NOTHING halts: the loop's status and steps are untouched, the request is open, and a person sees it (loop.control's openRequests, the notify warning) and acts with loop.stop or settles it with loop.control.dismiss. Per-loop (5) and per-agent (20) open limits are counted refusals (see loop-control-refused-request-limit).

params.reason: this loop is going in circles — a person should stop it
